messages:
fiona: Following up on the postmortem: we need a lightweight, enforceable action tracker for rollout safety. Key goals: 1) make remediation ownership explicit within 48h, 2) give hotfix vs. remediation SLAs, 3) surface recurring fingerprints with severity scoring.

alex: +1. Can we make the workflow create an "owner ticket" automatically from the postmortem with prefilled checklist items and an SLA label? e.g., `hotfix/48h`, `remediate/2w`.

marco: I like that. Also propose a three-strike recurrence policy: first recurrence = notify + low severity; second = require a mitigation plan in 7 days; third = force a rollout freeze + exec notif. We should compute a recurrence severity score (0-100) so analytics can sort.

fiona: Good — new items: (A) auto-create owner ticket on postmortem close with SLA tag, (B) attach the gating_config_id and the `guard.fingerprint` to the ticket, (C) compute a recurrence heat score and show on dashboard.

sre-bot: ACTION: when a postmortem is filed with `incident.type: rollout`, the bot will create a tracker story: `/create_tracker --type rollout --sla hotfix/48h --assign @owner` and attach `gating_config_id`.

alex: For the heat score, we can weight: recency (40%), count (30%), severity-of-signature (20%), and rollback-need (10%). Example formula: `heat = 0.4*exp(-age_days/30) * count_norm + ...` we'll refine.

marco: Also add an automated follow-up cadence: 48h owner ack, 7-day hotfix decision, 14-day remediation patch or schedule. If owner misses ack, escalate to squad lead and schedule an automatic review with SRE.

fiona: Draft of the ticket template (will be stored in /docs/rollout-tracker-template.md):

```
Title: [Tracker] <flag> - <model_variant> - <postmortem_id>
Fields:
  - gating_config_id: <g-...>
  - fingerprint: <sha256(flag|variant|signature_id)>
  - heat_score: <0-100>
  - sla: hotfix/48h or remediate/14d
  - owner: <@>
  - due_dates: {ack_by, decision_by, remediate_by}
Checklist:
  - attach gating config
  - baseline snapshots linked
  - telemetry counters confirmed: guard.quarantine, guard.fallback, guard.rollback, guard.fingerprint
  - recurrence review scheduled
```

alex: Runtime/telemetry asks: emit `guard.fingerprint` event, include `heat_score_v1` when recurrence job runs, and counters `guard.quarantine`/`guard.rollback`/`guard.fallback`. Also tag deploy events with `gating_config_id`.

marco: Analytics: weekly "fingerprint heat" job that computes heat_score and creates/updates tracker tickets. Three-strike policy implemented by counting distinct incidents with same fingerprint in 90 days. We'll auto-add labels `recurrence:1`, `recurrence:2`, `recurrence:3` and escalate on 3.

sre-bot: NOTE: tracker stories created by bot will include a short runbook snippet and a checkbox that blocks closure until `baseline snapshots` and `telemetry counters` are present.

fiona: Owners & timelines:
 - fiona: author RFC for tracker + ticket template (due: 3 business days)
 - alex: implement bot auto-creator + attach gating_config_id to deploy events (due: 2 weeks)
 - marco: heat-score algorithm + weekly heat job + recurrence automation (due: 3 weeks)
 - SRE: adopt the SLA escalation policy in oncall runbooks (owner: oncall team, due: 5 business days)

ops-bot: REMINDER: any RFC or PR that changes rollout defaults must include `./ci/rollout_tracker_smoke.sh` and a `postmortem.attachments` field with `gating_config_id`. Merge blocked without smoke passing.

alex: Small UX note: add `freeze_on_third_strike: boolean` in gating config so teams can opt-in to auto-freeze on strike 3. Default=false.

marco: Also track a simple metric `recurrence.repeat_rate` = count_of_fingerprints_with_more_than_one_occurrence / total_fingerprints over 90d; we'll aim to reduce repeat_rate by 30% in Q2.

fiona: I'll open the RFC and PRs today and wire up the tracker template. Will post links once done. Any objections?

alex: No objections. :+1:

marco: ack. I'll start prototyping the heat job and the escalation labels.

sre-bot: REMINDER: bot-created trackers will ping `@owner` in #eng-oncall and create a calendar slot for 48h ack by default.

fiona: Thanks team. Posting RFC link shortly.
